heading: none
name: 兩直欄圖片群＋靠上文字欄
desc: 左側是兩直欄、比例交錯的圖片群，撐滿整個區塊高；右側是靠上對齊的標題與說明文字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上下不留白，圖片群貼齊區塊的上下緣。左側約四成寬放圖片群：兩直欄並排，每欄由上而下疊放數張圖片，直式與橫式交錯，兩欄的圖片高度不同、分界上下錯開，但兩欄的頂端與底端對齊；圖片群決定整個區塊的高度。右側放文字欄，靠上對齊、靠左排列：大標題（可多行），下方是多段說明文字，上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；文字欄明顯比圖片群短，下方留大片空白。圖片群與文字欄都對齊頁面內容寬度。文字欄的右上角與右下角可各放一組小型裝飾圖形，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：小標籤、大標題與說明文字在上，圖片群移到區塊最下方；圖片群維持兩直欄、直式與橫式交錯，對齊頁面內容寬度並貼齊區塊下緣，區塊上方保留一般留白。裝飾圖形留在文字區的右上角與右下角。

en.name: Two-column image stack + top-aligned text column
en.desc: On the left, two vertical columns of images in alternating orientations fill the full section height; on the right, a top-aligned headline and description.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no spacing at top and bottom; the image group is flush with the section's top and bottom edges. On the left, about forty percent of the width holds the image group: two vertical columns side by side, each stacking several images from top to bottom, alternating portrait and landscape; the two columns use different image heights so their breaks are staggered, but the tops and bottoms of both columns align, and the image group sets the height of the whole section. On the right is a text column, aligned to the top and aligned left: a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) followed by several paragraphs of description, optionally with a label above; omit it when there is no content. The text column is clearly shorter than the image group, leaving a large empty area below it. Both the image group and the text column align to the page content width. Optionally place a small cluster of decorative graphics at the top-right and bottom-right corners of the text column; omit them when there is no content.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the label, headline and description on top, with the image group moved to the bottom of the section. The image group keeps its two vertical columns with alternating portrait and landscape images, aligns to the page content width and is flush with the section's bottom edge; the top of the section keeps normal spacing. The decorative graphics stay at the top-right and bottom-right corners of the text area.

extras.name: 圖片位置自動換圖
extras.prompt: 圖片群裡的每個圖片位置各自準備兩張以上的圖片，停留數秒後自動換成下一張，位置與大小不變，依序循環。

en.name: Auto-switching image slots
en.prompt: Each image slot in the image group holds two or more images; after staying for a few seconds it automatically switches to the next one, keeping the same position and size, and cycles in order.
en.mobile: Mobile keeps the automatic image switching.
